extra.message: User-controlled pageId parameter is concatenated directly into the SQL query string via string concatenation (pageId='+pageId') and passed to db.execute(). An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL by providing values like pageId=0 OR 1=1 in the URL path /dashboard/<>.

User-supplied input from request.form['data_obj] is written to '../pickle.hacker' and then deserialized using pickle.load() without any validation. An attacker can craft a malicious pickle payload that executes arbitrary code upon deserialization, leading to remote code execution.

The system_call function is exposed to templates via context processor and invokes os.popen(command) with an unsanitized command parameter. If any template passes user-controlled input to this utility function, it results in OS command injection allowing arbitrary remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command (OS Command Injection)

extra.message: User-supplied search input from request.form.get('search') is passed directly to render_template and X-XSS-Protection header is set to '0', disabling browser XSS filters. The rendered page will include the unescaped search query in the response, enabling stored/reflected cross-site scripting.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)

extra.message: request.url is directly interpolated into the HTML template via .format() on line 94 and displayed in page content on line 75. An attacker can craft a URL containing malicious JavaScript that gets reflected in the 404 response, enabling stored XSS.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)

extra.message: Unsanitized request.form['example_file'] is concatenated directly into the Content-Disposition HTTP response header on line 33 via 'attachment; filename='+fileName. User-supplied XML from request.form['customers'] is parsed via xml.dom.pulldom.parseString() without disabling external entity resolution. The default parser resolves DTDs and external entities, allowing attackers to read local files via file:// URIs in DOCTYPE declarations or conduct SSRF attacks.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference (XXE)

extra.message: The password 'admin' is hardcoded directly in the authentication logic on line 12. The application uses plaintext password comparison (password == 'admin') instead of proper password hashing and verification, making credential compromise trivial if source code is exposed.

SECRET_KEY is set to 'random' (extremely weak, easily guessable) and app.debug is set to True in /target/project/__init__.py line 5-6. A weak secret key allows session cookie forgery by attackers. Debug mode exposes the interactive debugger which can be exploited for remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-215: Information Exposure Through Debug Code

extra.message: CORS is configured with wildcard origin (origins: '*') on line 8 of runserver.py. Combined with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials set to 'true' in /confidential endpoint, any website can make authenticated cross-origin requests to this application, enabling cross-site data theft.
